compiled_state.title: Commit report to epic scratch artifact via --commit-to-epic
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-6: Report committed to epic (as scratch artifact, attachment, or referenced file) so audit trail records measurement evidence

## Description
Add `--commit-to-epic` flag. When set, after JSON report is written, also persist via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket scratch set <epic> measurement:report <json>`. Without flag, no scratch write. Scratch-CLI failure bubbles up as non-zero exit with clear stderr.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] --commit-to-epic invokes scratch CLI
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] Scratch CLI failure → non-zero harness exit
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] Without flag, no scratch write
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-token-reduction.py | Edit |
| tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.

comments.body: CHECKPOINT: Implementation complete. Added --commit-to-epic flag (orthogonal to --report). When set after report written, invokes bash .claude/scripts/dso ticket scratch set <test_epic_id> measurement:report <json> via commit_to_epic(). CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is pinned to the plugin dir containing this script (parent.parent of __file__) to ensure the correct ticket dispatcher is used regardless of caller env. Scratch CLI failure propagates as non-zero exit with clear stderr. Without --commit-to-epic flag, no scratch write. Test 15 verifies scratch file written; test 16 verifies no scratch write without flag. All 41 tests GREEN. ruff check passes.
